sentences.en: The discovery that language can be a barrier to communication is quickly made by all who travel, study, govern or sell.
sentences.zh: 任何旅行、学习、管理或出售的人,都很快发现语言会成为沟通的障碍。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Whether the activity is tourism, research, government, policing, business, or data dissemination, the lack of a common language can severely impede progress or can halt it altogether.
sentences.zh: 无论是旅游、研究、政府、治安、商业还是数据传播活动,缺乏共同语言都可能严重阻碍进展或完全停止进展。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；分词短语压缩了背景或附加动作。

sentences.en: ‘Common language’ here usually means a foreign language, but the same point applies in principle to any encounter with unfamiliar dialects or styles within a single language.
sentences.zh: ”共同语言”通常是指外语, 但原则上也适用于任何与单一语言中不熟悉的方言或风格的遭遇。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: ‘They don’t talk the same language’ has a major metaphorical meaning alongside its literal one.
sentences.zh: ”除了字面意义外, 也有重要的比喻意义。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Although communication problems of this kind must happen thousands of times each day, very few become public knowledge.
sentences.zh: 虽然这种交流问题每天必须发生数千次,但很少人成为公众知识。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Publicity comes only when a failure to communicate has major consequences, such as strikes, lost orders, legal problems, or fatal accidents — even, at times, war.
sentences.zh: 只有在不沟通有重大后果,例如罢工、命令丢失、法律问题或致命事故——有时甚至战争——时,才有公示。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: One reported instance of communication failure took place in 1970, when several Americans ate a species of poisonous mushroom.
sentences.zh: 1970年发生了一起报道的通信故障事件,当时几名美国人吃了一种有毒蘑菇。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: No remedy was known, and two of the people died within days.
sentences.zh: 无法找到任何补救办法,其中两人在几天内死亡。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: A radio report of the case was heard by a chemist who knew of a treatment that had been successfully used in 1959 and published in 1963.
sentences.zh: 一名化学家听取了关于该案件的电台报告,他知道1959年成功使用和1963年公布的治疗方法。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词。

sentences.en: Why had the American doctors not heard of it seven years later?
sentences.zh: 为什么七年后美国医生没听说过?

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Presumably because the report of the treatment had been published only in journals written in European languages other than English.
sentences.zh: 估计是因为治疗报告只发表在用英语以外的欧洲语言撰写的期刊上。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 状语从句
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Several comparable cases have been reported.
sentences.zh: 报告了几个可比案件。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: But isolated examples do not give an impression of the size of the problem — something that can come only from studies of the use or avoidance of foreign-language materials and contacts in different communicative situations.
sentences.zh: 但孤立的例子并不能给人造成问题规模的印象——这个问题只能来自在不同交流情况下使用或避免使用外语材料和接触的研究。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: In the English-speaking scientific world, for example, surveys of books and documents consulted in libraries and other information agencies have shown that very little foreign-language material is ever consulted.
sentences.zh: 例如,在英语科学世界,图书馆和其他信息机构查阅的书籍和文件调查显示,查阅外语材料很少。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Library requests in the field of science and technology showed that only 13 per cent were for foreign language periodicals.
sentences.zh: 图书馆在科学和技术领域的请求表明,只有13%是外语期刊。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Studies of the sources cited in publications lead to a similar conclusion: the use of foreignlanguage sources is often found to be as low as 10 per cent.
sentences.zh: 对出版物引用的资料来源的研究得出了类似的结论:外语资料来源的使用率往往低至10%。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The language barrier presents itself in stark form to firms who wish to market their products in other countries.
sentences.zh: 语言障碍对希望在其他国家推销其产品的公司来说,表现得十分明显。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: British industry, in particular, has in recent decades often been criticized for its linguistic insularity — for its assumption that foreign buyers will be happy to communicate in English, and that awareness of other languages is not therefore a priority.
sentences.zh: 特别是英国工业近几十年来常常因其语言的隔绝性而受到批评,因为英国工业假定外国买家会乐于用英语交流,因此对其他语言的认识不是优先事项。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In the 1960s, over two-thirds of British firms dealing with non-English-speaking customers were using English for outgoing correspondence; many had their sales literature only in English; and as many as 40 per cent employed no-one able to communicate in the customers’ languages.
sentences.zh: 1960年代,三分之二以上与非英语客户打交道的英国公司使用英语进行往来信函;许多公司只用英语提供销售文献;多达40%的公司没有能够用用户的语言进行通信。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: A similar problem was identified in other English-speaking countries, notably the USA, Australia and New Zealand.
sentences.zh: 其他英语国家,特别是美国、澳大利亚和新西兰也发现了类似的问题。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: And non-English-speaking countries were by no means exempt-although the widespread use of English as an alternative language made them less open to the charge of insularity.
sentences.zh: 非英语国家绝不例外,尽管广泛使用英语作为替代语言,使它们较少接受岛屿归属的责任。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The criticism and publicity given to this problem since the 1960s seems to have greatly improved the situation.
sentences.zh: 自1960年代以来,对这一问题的批评和公开宣传似乎大大改善了局势。

grammar.type: 状语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Industrial training schemes have promoted an increase in linguistic and cultural awareness.
sentences.zh: 工业培训计划促进了语言和文化意识的提高。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。

sentences.en: Many firms now have their own translation services; to take just one example in Britain, Rowntree Mackintosh now publish their documents in six languages (English, French, German, Dutch, Italian and Xhosa).
sentences.zh: 许多公司现在有自己的翻译服务;仅举英国的一个例子,Rowntree Mackintosh现在以六种语文(英文、法文、德文、荷兰文、意大利文和Xhosa文)出版文件。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: Some firms run part-time language courses in the languages of the countries with which they are most involved; some produce their own technical glossaries, to ensure consistency when material is being translated.
sentences.zh: 一些公司用它们最涉及的国家的语言开办非全日制语言课程;有些公司自行编制技术词汇,以确保材料翻译时的一致性。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 被动语态
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者。

sentences.en: It is now much more readily appreciated that marketing efforts can be delayed, damaged, or disrupted by a failure to take account of the linguistic needs of the customer.
sentences.zh: 现在人们更加认识到,销售工作可能因未能考虑到客户的语言需要而延误、损坏或中断。

grammar.type: 被动语态 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；“be + 过去分词”强调动作的承受者；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: The changes in awareness have been most marked in English-speaking countries, where the realisation has gradually dawned that by no means everyone in the world knows English well enough to negotiate in it.
sentences.zh: 认识的变化在英语国家最为明显,在那里,人们逐渐认识到,世界上每个人对英语都非常熟悉,因此不可能在英语中进行谈判。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: This is especially a problem when English is not an official language of public administration, as in most parts of the Far East, Russia, Eastern Europe, the Arab world, Latin America and French speaking Africa.
sentences.zh: 在英语不是公共行政的正式语言时,这尤其是一个问题,例如在远东、俄罗斯、东欧、阿拉伯世界、拉丁美洲和非洲法语地区的大部分地区。

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；连词引出时间、原因、条件或让步关系。

sentences.en: Even in cases where foreign customers can speak English quite well, it is often forgotten that they may not be able to understand it to the required level — bearing in mind the regional and social variation which permeates speech and which can cause major problems of listening comprehension.
sentences.zh: 即使外国顾客能够讲得相当好,人们也常常忘记,他们可能无法理解英语达到要求的水平,因为演讲中充满区域和社会差异,可能造成听力理解方面的重大问题。

grammar.type: 定语从句 + 不定式结构
grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；which/who/where 引导的部分用来补充说明前面的名词；to do 常表示目的、结果或对前面内容的补充。

sentences.en: In securing understanding, how ‘we’ speak to ‘them’ is just as important, it appears, as how ‘they’ speak to ‘us’.
sentences.zh: 与「他们」如何与「我们」沟通同样重要,

grammar.note: 先抓主句主干；按主语、谓语和宾语／表语的顺序先抓句子主干。
